evidence: Arithmetic and small reference calculations on one lake model's columns: the waters' oxygen study's deep lakes (biosphere/ecology/lake.py, unchanged) rerun from their own settled columns with the column saved daily. Methane is the model's debt of reduced substances times a methane share from Earth's low-sulphate lakes; CO2 is what the water respired since it left the surface, in the lake's carbonate system; the gas saturation ratio sets them, with N2 and Ar at the surface's saturation, against the local pressure at lunar gravity. Sediment ebullition is the steady porewater balance of Bazhin as Langenegger et al. (2019) apply it, checked against Lake Soppen; bubbles rise with a contaminated-bubble drag and Froessling or Higbie transfer at lunar gravity. Oxidation shares, phosphorus release rates, loads and the remedies' energy are Earth's published values. No lunar lake has been measured, and the model carries no methane, CO2 or phosphorus of its own.
reading_rule: Concentrations in mol/m3 (mmol/L) or umol/L as named; fluxes in mol or g per m2 of lake surface a year unless named per m2 of floor; Tg of CH4 a year Moon-wide over geography's 3.92 million km2 of rain-fed lakes. deep_lakes are keyed deep_<target>_<band>, each trophic state at the central renewal/supply column; methane_made is the anoxic mineralization's methane at the low, central and high methane share. saturation_ratio is the dissolved gases' pressure over the local pressure: 1 is the bubble point. hazard_map gives years for an isolated hypolimnion to reach it at its floor. survival lists by depths_m the share of a bubble's methane reaching the air. methane.<target>.traits gives the flux by trophic state with low/central/high brackets; air gives the steady state and dimming with the lakes in the ledger, each pair the low- and high-cost ends of the domain synthesis. phosphorus loads are g P m-2 a-1; remedies per km2 of lake.
